updates.header_tagline: Builds the systems that turn information into decisions.
updates.positioning_summary: Senior finance and strategy executive, 20 years across global wealth, asset management, and pensions. CFA charterholder, economist by training. I build the planning systems, insight functions, and governance that turn what an organization knows into the decisions it acts on. I have built FP&A, analytics, and insight functions from scratch, partnered directly with CFOs and COOs, and led global teams.
